items.title: Billy Taylor — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Monk and Randy Western had chose to do

ctx.x: So at the time you made this recording was Monk’s style influential?

No. No, as a matter of fact he was being steadily put down by all the writers and I remember a few years… even later then that when he did some recording with Norman Grant, he was referred to in the notes as an iterant piano player. I mean people were very disrespectful of what he was doing because they didn’t understand it. They just thought that he was a guy that played a lot of clunkers, that he missed a lot and everything, not understanding that his sense of rhythm was as special as it was and that he was…
And this relationship between Monk and Bud, were you also a part of this then? Did you get to experience some of their interchanges or did you get to see, interact with them?
